_comment: Known Issues Catalog — managed by Accounting Seed T3/KB team.
_instructions: This file is fetched by the issueDetector LWC in every subscriber org via the KnownIssueCatalog Named Credential.
Updates to this file are live in all orgs within 4 hours (the client-side cache TTL).
developerName   — unique key, no spaces, used in Case description prefix
label           — short human-readable name shown in the suggestion card
errorPattern    — JavaScript-compatible regex (case-insensitive); test at regex101.com before publishing
matchContext    — optional regex matched against window.location.pathname; leave blank to match any page
signalSource    — one of: Toast | Console | Apex | Any
summary         — one sentence shown to the user; include the resolution hint if short enough
kbArticleUrl    — full URL to the KB article; leave blank if not yet published
kbArticleId     — Salesforce Knowledge article ID; optional
walkthroughName — KBShowMe__mdt DeveloperName for Shepherd.js tour (PROD-492); leave blank if no tour
active          — set to false to disable a pattern without deleting it

issues.label: Billing Post: Closed Accounting Period
issues.summary: This error occurs when posting a Billing whose Accounting Period is closed. Reopen the period or change the Billing date to an open period.

issues.label: Cash Receipt: Overapplied Amount
issues.summary: The amount being applied exceeds the Cash Receipt balance. Reduce the applied amount or unapply an existing allocation before reapplying.

issues.label: Posting Blocked: Inactive GL Account
issues.summary: A GL Account on this transaction is marked Inactive. Reactivate the GL Account in the Chart of Accounts or update the transaction to use an active account.

issues.label: Period Close: Unposted Records Exist
issues.summary: The Accounting Period cannot be closed while unposted transactions exist. Post or delete all pending records before closing the period.

issues.label: Recurring Billing: Incorrect Next Bill Date
issues.summary: The Next Bill Date on a Recurring Billing record is showing incorrectly after a new invoice was created. Refresh the record and verify the date before the next cycle runs.

issues.label: Issue Reporter Smoke Test
issues.summary: Test pattern for validating the Issue Reporter + Detector in scratch orgs. Run console.error('[IR_TEST] ...') in the browser console to trigger it.
